name: apply_patch
description: Apply localized edits from inline text or a patch file. Supports line replacement, patch envelopes, and unified diffs.
first_use_guidance:
Guidance for later patches in this turn:
- Copy source text exactly without `read_file` line prefixes; context lines must match.
- For `*** Replace in line:`, provide `anchor:`, `old:`, and `new:` inside a `*** Begin Patch` envelope.
- Patch envelopes support `*** Update File:`, `*** Add File:` with `+`-prefixed content, and `*** Delete File:` plus `@@` hunks.
- Multi-file unified diffs split automatically, but unified diffs cannot delete files.
- `file_path` is only needed for a single-file unified diff whose headers do not identify the target.
- `patch` and `patch_file` are mutually exclusive; the limits are 8000 and 64000 characters respectively.

file_path.description: Absolute target for a single-file unified diff when its headers omit the file; `path` is an alias.

patch.description: Inline edit in exactly one form: `*** Replace in line:` inside a `*** Begin Patch` envelope; an envelope with `*** Update/Add/Delete File:` sections and `@@` hunks; or a unified diff. No Markdown fences or no-op edits. Limit: 8000 characters.

patch_file.description: Patch-file path instead of `patch`; must be session-temp or under the working directory. Mutually exclusive with `patch`; limit 64000 characters.
